q09. AIService

The `Transcribe` RPC is defined in `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto` (lines 11–20), inside `service AIService` in package `memos.api.v1`. It takes a `TranscribeRequest`, returns a `TranscribeResponse`, and is mapped to `POST /api/v1/ai:transcribe`. The generated code confirms this in `proto/gen/api/v1/ai_service.pb.go` and `proto/gen/api/v1/ai_service.pb.gw.go`, where the method appears as `memos.api.v1.AIService.Transcribe`.
